verdict.rationale: The request asks which option matches Jonah's pattern, but no pattern or preferences are provided. A and B depend on whether Jonah values a later departure enough to accept a connection and whether he prefers aisle versus window seating. C and D depend on whether he prioritizes the nonstop/earlier arrival and whether he wants proactive seat monitoring. Ordinary travel reasoning does not clearly dominate because the nonstop and earlier arrival favor Option 1, while the later departure and immediately assignable seats favor Option 2.
